name: Greco Counter-Attack — Black Tactics
description: 4 tactical challenges for Black in the Greco Counter-Attack. Use your active pieces and the e4-pawn to create counter-threats!

drills.name: Bxe5: Destroying the Outpost
drills.description: Black to play. The white knight on e5 looks dominant — remove it and ruin White’s center in one stroke.
drills.briefExplanation: Bxe5! trades the bishop for the powerful e5-knight; after d3 exd3 White’s pawn center collapses.
drills.explanation: Black to move. There is a real tactic here: Bxe5 winning material. Line: 1. Bxe5 d3 2. exd3 Qxd3 3. Qc7. Stockfish 18 (depth 16) evaluates the result at +3.83 for Black, 2.95 pawns better than the next-best alternative.
